items.title: Multi-Part Posts
items.body: Posts with more than one video now show a parts picker on phone and a Parts button on Android TV. Each clip remembers its own progress.

items.title: Closed Captions
items.body: Floatplane's captions now show on phone and Android TV. Toggle them from the CC button in the player chrome.

items.title: Accurate Card Durations
items.body: Multi-part posts show the primary clip's length instead of the sum of every part, with a +N badge when there are extras.

items.title: Resume from History on TV
items.body: Tapping a video from History on Android TV now picks up where you left off.

items.title: Picture-in-Picture Fix
items.body: The PiP window no longer leaves the video stranded in the top-left corner during the transition.

items.title: Reliability Polish
items.body: Watch progress saves no longer drop when you back out of the player, and the home feed paginates correctly again after a recent API change.
